implementation_statement: No written access control policy existed before this engagement. POL-02 Access Control (P06), which also carries the program governance rules, was approved 2026-08-31 and takes effect 2026-09-01. A one-page account procedure for platform, SYS-02, and suite accounts is due 2026-09-30

The Lead Platform Engineer creates platform accounts for staff and the first administrator for each agency; agency administrators manage their own users (AC-01 users come from the sheriff's identity provider). The MSP creates and disables suite accounts on the Operations Manager's request. Gaps: no written account types or approvals; no periodic review; the support role reads every workspace; agency user lists for AC-03 and AC-04 have never been reconciled with the cities
evidence: Platform user and role export; suite user export; onboarding emails

implementation_statement: The platform enforces workspace separation and role-based access configured by the company: agency users see only their own workspace; within AC-01, records are limited by unit; in AC-02, payment approval is limited to supervisors
evidence: Platform role configuration export; vendor SOC 2 report

implementation_statement: Staff have no local administrator rights on laptops (MSP policy). Gaps: the owner and the Lead Platform Engineer use their administrator accounts for daily work; both Platform Developers can promote changes to production and read production data; the support role can read every workspace including CJI
evidence: Platform role export; MSP endpoint policy

implementation_statement: The platform locks a local account after 10 failed sign-ins in 30 minutes (tenant setting). CJIS requires no more than 5 consecutive invalid attempts in 15 minutes for systems holding CJI. AC-01 users sign in through the sheriff's identity provider, which applies the sheriff's lockout; the gap is the staff and support accounts that reach the AC-01 workspace

Laptops lock after 15 minutes idle (MSP policy). The platform ends idle sessions after 60 minutes for local accounts. CJIS allows at most 30 minutes before a device lock. Gap: the platform session setting has not been aligned
evidence: MSP policy report; platform session settings

implementation_statement: Staff reach the platform and the suite over TLS with MFA from any location. SYS-02 is administered over SSH with keys only. The MSP reaches every laptop through its remote management platform (SYS-08). Gaps: SSH has no second factor; the MSP's remote access is not limited or logged for the company
evidence: SYS-02 security group rules; MSP contract

implementation_statement: Agency data may be handled only on company laptops (habit, now written in POL-02). For SC-01, only laptops on the revenue agency CISO's approved device list may connect to the agency virtual desktop. Gap: in June 2026 the Lead Platform Engineer connected twice from a laptop not on that list
evidence: Agency CISO approval letter (2 devices); agency virtual desktop connection report
regulatory_driver: Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 4 AC-20 IRS-defined)

implementation_statement: 4 staff complete CJIS security awareness training through the sheriff's online program before access and every year; the Integration Consultant completes the revenue agency's disclosure awareness training every year. Gaps: no training for the other staff; no phishing exercises; the Lead Platform Engineer's FTI recertification is overdue since June 2026
evidence: Sheriff training records; agency training certificate
regulatory_driver: Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 AT-2); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7 II(4))

implementation_statement: The platform records sign-ins, record views, changes, exports, and administrator actions in the tenant audit log. SYS-02 writes system and SSH logs locally. Gap: SYS-02 does not log file access to the CHRI working folder, and the provider's account activity log is not enabled for the storage bucket
evidence: Platform audit log sample; SYS-02 log configuration

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: No one reviews platform, SYS-02, or suite logs. A monthly review of administrator actions, bulk exports, and failed sign-ins, with a short checklist, starts 2026-10-31

The platform keeps tenant audit logs 90 days (vendor default); SYS-02 keeps 14 days. CJIS requires at least 1 year. A weekly export of platform audit logs and SYS-02 logs to write-once storage in a separate account, kept 1 year, is due 2026-10-31
evidence: Platform log retention setting; SYS-02 log rotation file

implementation_statement: An independent consultant assessed 14 controls on 2026-08-17 to 2026-08-19 (P07). POL-01 pointer and POL-02 Part A require an independent assessment every year
No continuous monitoring strategy. The monthly security meeting (owner and Operations Manager) tracks the POA&M and the monthly log review from 2026-09
Application configurations are exported to the repository after each release. SYS-02 has no documented baseline; it was built by hand in 2024 and changed since

Changes are built in the sandbox and promoted by a Platform Developer after an informal check by the Lead Platform Engineer. Gap: no change record or approval for production promotions or SYS-02 changes; agencies are not told in advance of changes to their workspace

No inventory of components or of where agency data lives existed before the 2026-07-29 data inventory, which found the FTI spill. A one-page inventory of devices, SaaS services, and agency data locations is due 2026-09-30
No contingency plan. A short plan built from the BIA (P05), with the vendor restore request steps, SYS-02 rebuild steps, and agency workarounds, is due 2026-11-30
No restore test has ever been run, from the nightly exports or through the vendor's tenant restore. A first test restoring the AC-01 export into the sandbox is due 2026-10-31, then quarterly

Platform vendor: continuous backup (platform RPO 1 hour), 14 days kept, full-tenant restore within 48 hours on request. Company: nightly export of all workspaces to a bucket in the SYS-02 account, kept 30 days. Gaps: the export copy is not immutable, shares administrator keys with SYS-02, gives a 24-hour recovery point against the 4-hour contract term, and has never been restored
Platform recovery is the vendor's. SYS-02 recovery is a manual rebuild from repository scripts that only the Lead Platform Engineer has done

Every staff member has a named suite account and a named platform account. Agency users have named accounts; AC-01 users sign in through the sheriff's identity provider. No shared accounts in the platform or suite

MFA is enforced for every staff account in the platform (authenticator codes) and the suite (authenticator push), including administrators. Gap: SYS-02 administrator access is SSH key only, with no second factor; the bucket's console access uses the IaaS account with MFA, but its access keys sit on SYS-02
evidence: Platform and suite MFA reports; SYS-02 SSH configuration

implementation_statement: MFA is enforced for AC-02 and AC-03 platform-local users and by the sheriff for AC-01 users. Gap: AC-04 users (about 15) sign in with a password only

Platform password rules: 12 characters minimum and a breached-password check. Gaps: SSH private keys on 2 laptops are not passphrase-protected; no rotation of the sheriff file-drop credential since 2024
No incident handling capability was written down before this engagement. POL-03 (P06) and the P08 runbook were approved 2026-08-31; the first tabletop exercise with the MSP is due 2026-11-30

The platform vendor scans and patches the platform (inherited). No scanning of SYS-02 or laptops. An authenticated monthly scan of SYS-02 through the MSP's tool is due 2026-10-31

implementation_statement: All platform traffic uses TLS 1.2 or higher (inherited). SYS-02 pulls the sheriff's file over SFTP and calls the platform API over TLS

The platform vendor's August 2026 letter states its TLS endpoints use FIPS 140-3 certified modules. Gap: the SFTP pull on SYS-02 uses the operating system's default library, and FIPS mode is not enabled. CJIS stops accepting FIPS 140-2 certificates after 2026-09-21; switch due 2026-09-18
evidence: Vendor letter; SYS-02 crypto policy output

implementation_statement: Platform data is encrypted at rest by the vendor (inherited). SYS-02 disks and the bucket use the provider's default encryption. Laptops use built-in full-disk encryption (MSP). Gap: CHRI files kept 30 days in the SYS-02 working folder with no file-level protection and no deletion after load
evidence: Vendor documentation; MSP encryption report; SYS-02 folder listing

evidence: MSP patch report (July 2026); SYS-02 package report
